name: Toolbar
intent: The bar above a list or table: find and filter on the left, view and actions on the right, with a filter bar that opens under it.
usage: Put one Toolbar right above a list or table, under the PageHeader. It is one component. Left: a Filters button (when filters are passed), carrying a kit Count of how many filters are on and a search field, which with searchGroups opens a kit Command dropdown of quick-navigation results; then, after a divider, the view picker and refresh. Right: a More menu and the actions, kit Buttons size sm with at most one primary, last. Filters toggles the filter bar under it: the filter chips (kit DropdownMenu trigger filter), then Reset and Apply filters, and an optional help icon at the end. Every part is optional; leave out what the list does not need. See contracts/toolbar.json for the full contract. Under 640px, the kit's mobile break, one line cannot hold the finding and the doing: the search takes the first line whole, the filters, the view and refresh share the next, and the actions keep to the end of their own, with the one primary last.

filters.note: Filter chips for the filter bar: kit DropdownMenu with trigger filter (or ButtonFilter). Adds the Filters button that opens the bar.

filterCount.note: How many filters are on. Above zero the Filters button carries a kit Count, so a folded filter bar still says the list is narrowed.

filtersOpen.note: Controlled: the filter bar is open. The Filters button shows pressed.

defaultFiltersOpen.note: Starting state when filtersOpen is not controlled.

onReset.note: () => void. Adds Reset to the filter bar.

onApply.note: () => void. Adds Apply filters (check icon) to the filter bar.

filterHelp.note: Adds a help icon at the end of the filter bar that opens a kit HelpPopover with this text.

onSearchChange.note: (value: string) => void. Adds the search field.

searchGroups.itemShape: { heading?: string; items: { id: string; label: string; description?: string; icon?: string }[] }
searchGroups.note: Quick navigation results. The search field becomes a trigger that opens a kit Command (size sm) laid over it, same width. Typed text shows bold in the results.

onSearchSelect.note: (id: string) => void. A result was picked. The dropdown closes.

onSearchViewAll.note: (query: string) => void. Adds View all results for <query> as the last row. The field then shows the query.

views.note: View options, like List View and Board View. Adds a picker that shows the current one.

view.note: id of the current view. Leave it out and the Toolbar tracks it, starting with the first.

onRefresh.note: () => void. Adds a refresh icon button named by a Tooltip.

moreActions.itemShape: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; danger?: boolean } | { divider: true }
moreActions.note: Adds a tertiary More menu before the actions for less-used ones. Delete goes last, as danger. Give each one its Material Symbols icon, as the row menus in a table do, so the menu reads at a glance.

actions.note: Kit Buttons size sm: secondary first, one primary last. At most five visible actions including More.

label.note: Names the toolbar group for screen readers.

useWhen: Right above a list or table that people search, filter, switch views on or act on.
A page with several filters: they live in the filter bar, not across the page.
doNot: Do not invent a FilterBar, ListToolbar or a local row of controls above a table.
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions.
Do not put page titles or breadcrumbs in it. Those are the PageHeader.
Do not use Tabs or ButtonGroup for the view picker. Pass views.
a11y: A group named by label. Filters is a kit Button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the filter bar, and shows pressed while it is open.

The search is a kit Input named by its placeholder. With searchGroups it is a button (aria-haspopup=dialog) that opens a kit Command combobox over it; Escape clears, then closes and returns focus. The view picker, More and filter chips are kit DropdownMenus.
Refresh and the help icon are icon buttons named by a kit Tooltip or HelpPopover.
The filter bar is a group named Filters. Tab order runs left to right, then into the filter bar.
snippet:
<Toolbar
  filters={filterChips}
  onReset={resetFilters}
  onApply={applyFilters}
  onSearchChange={setQuery}
  views={[{ id: "list", label: "List View" }, { id: "board", label: "Board View" }]}
  onRefresh={reload}
  actions={<>
    <Button size="sm">Export</Button>
    <Button size="sm" variant="primary">Create</Button>
  </>}
/>

examples.title: Closed
examples.usage: Filters, search, view and refresh on the left; More, Export and the one primary Create on the right. Click the search for quick navigation; type Sales.

examples.title: Filter bar open
examples.usage: Filters is pressed and the bar shows the chips, Reset, Apply filters and help. A set chip shows its value; click its name to switch it off.

props.filterHelp: Filters narrow the list. Switch a filter off to keep it without applying it.

examples.title: Search only
examples.usage: Leave out what the list does not need.
